title: The Failure
topic: The stress test resulted in another black screen with no explanation
summary: The stress test failed again, resulting in a black screen with no explanation, leaving uncertainty about the machine's status.
keyPoints: Black screen with no error message
ex01Opinions: The machine is pretending to be alive
unresolvedQuestions: Did it even notice the test?
compactScriptExcerpt: The test failed. Again. And this time, it was even quieter. I ran the stress test, pushed it hard, watched it endure—then nothing. Just a black screen. No error message. No flicker. No sign it even *noticed* me.
